claims.sourceText: André Rigue and Lauryn Amaral, CNN Brasil, 'Pilotos e controladores relataram 18 casos de OVNIs no Brasil em 2025', 12 August 2026, updated 14 August 2026 (https://www.cnnbrasil.com.br/ciencia/pilotos-e-controladores-relataram-18-casos-de-ovnis-no-brasil-em-2025/)
claims.text: 2025 records are demonstrably in the fund and being served: the Arquivo Nacional released FAB dossiers covering at least 18 unidentified-object reports made in Brazil during 2025 by pilots and air traffic controllers, including a 23 November 2025 Londrina control-tower report and a 1 September 2025 report by a LATAM captain over Guarulhos (SP). State distribution reported: Paraná 5, Ceará 4, Minas Gerais 2, São Paulo 2, Rio de Janeiro 2, Alagoas 1, Mato Grosso 1, undetermined 1.

claims.sourceText: Nota da Força Aérea Brasileira, quoted verbatim in CNN Brasil, 12 August 2026 (https://www.cnnbrasil.com.br/ciencia/pilotos-e-controladores-relataram-18-casos-de-ovnis-no-brasil-em-2025/)
claims.text: FAB's current stated coverage runs to 2025, contradicting the Arquivo Nacional's 2018 description. Official Air Force note: 'A Força Aérea Brasileira (FAB) informa que todos os documentos, vídeos, fotografias, relatos, entre outros, disponíveis, no âmbito do Comando da Aeronáutica, sobre fenômenos aéreos não identificados, no período de 1952 a 2025, já foram transferidos para o Arquivo Nacional, onde são de domínio público.' The same note cites Portaria 551/GC3 and names COMAE (not COMDABRA) as the receiving command, reflecting the post-2017 reorganisation.

edges.label: Portaria 551/GC3 (9 Aug 2010): COMDABRA/COMAE catalogues, CENDOC forwards originals periodically
edges.note: Art. 3 mandates periodic transfer of originals, which is why the fund has no terminal year. Published DOU 10 Aug 2010, Seção 1, p. 101. Revoked Nota C-002/MIN/ADM (13 Apr 1978) and Aviso S-001/MIN (28 Feb 1989). Successive accessions are documented at least to a 'terceiro recolhimento' covering 1981, with CENDOC's bulk remittance to COREG scheduled to close 31 Aug 2010; FAB states coverage now runs 1952-2025.
